customers_say: Customers find the water purifier to be a very good quality product that functions well and delivers great-tasting water. They appreciate its premium appearance, hassle-free installation, and maintenance-free operation for the first two years. The filter life receives mixed reviews, with some customers reporting malfunction within a month.
